instruction: Pre-seal flower and botanical boundary check; preserve wording; report membership above ten and propose complete revisions before making them.

candidateSimpleFlowerGroup.englishGloss: Unspecified small or plain flowers used as a decorative visual motif

itemRationales.text: Bu yazmayı bağlamadan önce çiçek oyalarının yönünü tek tek düzelttim.
Omuz boyunca yayılan yemeninin kenarında üç boyutlu küçük oya çiçekleri bulunuyor.
itemRationales.rationale: Small three-dimensional lace flowers explicitly described.

itemRationales.text: Eller, başörtüsünün çiçekli iğne oyası bordürünü düz bir çizgide açıyor.
Yakalık kenarında sık aralıklı halka dikişleriyle yapılmış çiçekler bulunuyor.
itemRationales.rationale: Flowers made from chain stitches are explicitly described.

itemRationales.text: Omuzluktaki çiçekler, yoğun sırma sargılarıyla kumaştan yukarı kabarıyor.
itemRationales.rationale: Raised gilt flowers are explicitly described.

itemRationales.text: İki el, yarım kalmış çiçek işlemesini taşıyan ahşap kasnağı kaldırıyor.
itemRationales.rationale: An unfinished flower embroidery is the hoop subject.

itemRationales.text: Kumaştan kesilen çiçek içleri, nakışla desteklenmiş delikli bir yüzey oluşturuyor.
Kekik çiçeklerinin minicik kümelerini mendile sığdırmak için ince iplik seçtim.
itemRationales.rationale: Tiny thyme flower clusters have no specific distinguishing floral anatomy in the item.

itemRationales.text: Bu fuların deseninde küçük yapraklı dalların uçları pembe noktalarla dolu.
itemRationales.rationale: Terminal pink dots were authored to depict the same ordinary thyme flower heads; count conservatively.

itemRationales.text: Mendil nakışında küçük oval yapraklı kekik dalları, sık çiçek kümeleri taşıyor.
itemRationales.rationale: Small flowers on oval-leaved thyme branches retain the ordinary clustered-flower motif.

itemRationales.text: Fular yüzeyinde yere yayılan ince dallar ve pembe kekik çiçekleri bulunuyor.
itemRationales.rationale: Pink thyme flowers on spreading stems retain ordinary small blossoms.

itemRationales.text: Fuların ucundaki biberiye nakşını bitirince araya iki küçük çiçek ekledim.
itemRationales.rationale: Two unspecified small flowers are substantively added to the rosemary embroidery.

itemRationales.text: Fular ucunda ince yapraklı dal ve soluk renkli küçük çiçekler işlenmiş.
itemRationales.rationale: The item explicitly describes unspecified small flowers with a thin-leaved branch.

candidateSimpleFlowerGroup.groupingRule: Shared plain-flower motif crosses lace, chain embroidery, raised metallic work, hoop photography and cutwork. Technique, textile, garment location and named herbs without distinct flower anatomy do not split it.

counterpartChecks.result: Oya or geometric lace borders without substantive flowers; triangle points and an open knot network remain non-floral.
Branch, chain-stitch lines or stitch loops are described; no flower shape is substantively expressed.
Branches, general vegetal work, garment history or unspecified raised ornament are expressed; a plain flower is not asserted by these individual texts.
Hoop, shadow and a general work-in-progress view; no flower motif is expressed.
Cutwork openings and bridges are expressed without a specified flower shape.

botanicalTaxaBoundaryReview.englishGloss: Upright cup-shaped flowers, including tulip and crocus
botanicalTaxaBoundaryReview.reason: Tulip and crocus may share a cup-flower silhouette; named taxa alone do not split that morphology. This is a conservative extra label across their independent print-making and plant motifs. Generic block-printing counterparts 418/420 express no flower.

botanicalTaxaBoundaryReview.englishGloss: A slender branch carrying narrow leaves
botanicalTaxaBoundaryReview.reason: Conservative shared branch architecture across olive and rosemary. Olive fruit and rosemary needle references remain other substantive details; the shared leaf-bearing branch can carry a second label.

botanicalTaxaBoundaryReview.result: Existing conservative mint/nettle merge retained, count eight.
An elevated whorl/crown of hanging bells with a leafy crest differs structurally from a solitary nodding snowdrop on a curved stalk with three long petals.
Bound narrow flower spikes differ from a hanging flower cluster attached to a long linden bract. The bract and spike architecture support distinct botanical motifs.
Frost crystallization and branching ice geometry express a non-botanical motif.
Grapevine climbing a frame, strawberry runners producing another rooted plant, and silkworms eating a leaf are compound narratives; generic foliage alone does not equate those scenarios.

items.completeProposedText: Haşhaş kapsülü biçimli broşun tepesindeki düz yıldız, bütün kıyafetin küçük sürprizi.
Bu fuların kuru kapsüllerinden dökülen minik tohumlar desenin boşluklarına dağılıyor.
Broşta yuvarlak tohum kapsülünün tepesinde, kenarları ışınsal düz bir taç bulunuyor.
Fular baskısında açılmış kapsül deliklerinden dökülen küçük siyah tohumlar görülüyor.

completeRevisionProposal.reason: Four independently authored poppy seed-capsule items replace the generic thyme-flower set with a crowned seed pod and dispersing seeds. This removes four members from the thirteen-item candidate while keeping the caption/alt split and 1,000 total unchanged.
completeRevisionProposal.subsequentWorkAfterAuthorization: Apply only the approved complete revisions, add the three conservative cross-concept labels, rerun permitted mechanical audits, and update source SHA, exact memberships, maximum glosses and final attestations.

blindness: Only own Turkish source and existing own audit metadata inspected in this boundary check. No repair, policies, screening, new cases or development inspection.
authorization: Root explicitly accepted the conservative thirteen-item flower union and authorized complete individual replacements of rows 653 through 656 before sealing, with all other wording unchanged. Original boundary instruction authorizes conservative cross-concept label annotations within the ten-member cap.

checkedExistingGroups.distinction: Loose striped sunflower achenes and split shells differ from an intact crowned seed capsule with dispensing pores.
A scaly cup around one acorn, leafy nut husks, and an open spiny chestnut burr have distinct outer structures from a smooth poppy capsule with a flat radiating crown and dispersing tiny seeds.
Cut fleshy fruits display an internal pit or seed chambers. The new motif is an exterior dry capsule with crown and seed-release holes; its star is on the capsule top, unlike the internal pome core.
Fibrous insect cocoons and an emerging butterfly are separate biological structures and narratives.

seedCapsuleBoundaryCheck.result: Distinctive seed-capsule scenario; no existing capsule morphology or seed-release narrative duplicated or split.
